S. 289 | Youth Poisoning Protection Act | Sen. Tammy Duckworth (D-IL) | Commerce, Science, and Transportation Committee

📅 3 August 2026 | ✅🏛️ Passed Senate (voice vote)
What's next: To the House (if and when it takes it up)

Summary: The bill would ban the sale of consumer products containing 10% or more sodium nitrite, with exceptions for drugs, medical devices, cosmetics, and food products. It aims to protect young people from accidental or intentional poisoning through access to high-concentration sodium nitrite products.

S. 2666 | Foreign Robocall Elimination Act | Sen. Ted Budd (R-NC) | Commerce, Science, and Transportation Committee

📅 3 August 2026 | ✅🏛️ Passed Senate with amendment (unanimous consent)
What's next: To the House (if and when it takes it up)

Summary: The bill would establish an interagency task force to advise federal agencies and Congress on combating robocalls originating from outside the United States. It would also extend the term for the Federal Communications Commission's designation of an industry consortium responsible for tracing unlawful robocalls from annual to once every three years.

text:
H.R. 6500 | AGOA Extension Act | Rep. Jason Smith (R-MO) | Ways and Means Committee

📅 3 August 2026 | 🗳️ Motion to proceed filed
What's next: The Senate votes on taking it up (the motion can be withdrawn)

Summary: The bill would extend through the end of 2028 duty-free trade benefits that allow most exports from eligible sub-Saharan African countries to enter the U.S. market without tariffs, while also extending customs user fees through the end of 2031. It would also allow for refunds of duties paid on African imports that entered the country after September 30, 2025.
